cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: It Was Foreshadowed
cards.instruction: Turn the failure into a planned turning point by returning to earlier details that now appear to predict it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I pulled out the dowel when you pulled yours. That first wobble told everyone the cake was heading somewhere exciting.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I pulled a skewer out after testing it. Yours was holding the top tier up.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly, the moment it stopped being predictable. The wobble prepared them for this.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's a heap now. I can serve it in bowls, but nobody gets a slice.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Bring the bowls. Tell them the wobble was their first clue we weren't doing ordinary slices tonight.

reason: Replace unsupported confidence framing with a specific copied misconception that directs the Drive, retaining seed causality only where it remains understandable in the actual dialogue.
